mentions.name: Pacecar
mentions.description: This GitHub App reviews pull requests by commenting on PR open and update events, including drafts. It is built to be cheap enough to keep running and fast enough to avoid waiting, addressing PR review as the bottleneck in AI coding workflows.
mentions.problem: The bottleneck in most AI coding workflows is the actual PR review
mentions.audience: The bottleneck in most AI coding workflows is the actual PR review
